deadline.quote: Application period for Bachelor's degree programmes (excluding Bachelor's in Human Medicine) starting in autumn semester 2027: Applicants with a Swiss school-leaving certificate from 1 December 2026 00:00 to 30 April 2027 23:59 CET. Applicants with a foreign school-leaving certificate from 1 December 2026 00:00 to 31 March 2027 23:59 CET.
deadline.notes: ETH's official application portal eApply (www.lehrbetrieb.ethz.ch, an ethz.ch host), landing page as served to the production user agent. Closes 31 March 2027, 23:59 CET, for applicants with a foreign school-leaving certificate, autumn semester 2027 start (ETH Bachelor studies start only in the autumn semester). The German language requirement must also be met by 31 March (how-to-apply page). Applicants whose certificate requires the ETH entrance examination have an earlier timetable (dates page https://ethz.ch/en/studies/bachelor/application/non-swiss-matriculation-certificate/dates.html).
